mass.formula: slab_area_density(t) * (W*H - A_glass) + rho_glass * t_glass * A_glass + hardware
mass.source: Steel Door Institute (SDI) hollow metal door weights ~ 18ga 3'0x7'0 ≈ 100-110 lb; 16ga ≈ 120-135 lb

hinge.formula: mu*(m*g*r_thrust + 2*F_h*r_pin)*k_cond + seal_steady; F_h = m g (W/2)/span; seal_steady = min(3, 0.03*R*L*W/2) (gasket compression itself is the soft stop contact)

closer.formula: tau(theta) = tau0 + k*theta; tau0 = 1.15*EN1154 closing moment(size); tau90 = 0.85*EN1154 opening moment

damage.notes: Damage events are labelled when contact force / joint torque exceed these thresholds (see benchmark/labels.py)

compliance.notes: ADA 2010 §404.2.9 (5 lbf interior), IBC §1010.1.3 (30 lbf set in motion / 15 lbf full open), §1010.1.10 (panic 15 lbf)

robot.note: nominal humanoid used for the expected-transit-time formula and the start-zone clearance

scenarios.name: open_and_traverse
scenarios.description: Start in the start zone, reach the handle, unlatch, open and walk through the door plane to the goal zone.

randomize.formula: r = R*sqrt(u1), phi = 2*pi*u2, yaw = yaw0 + (2*u3 - 1)*yaw_jitter; u ~ U(0,1) from random.Random(seed_base + seed)

event_descriptions.touch_handle: robot contacts the operator (handle / bar / pull) or moves the operator joint by >10 % of its travel
event_descriptions.unlatch: latch bolt retracted >= 80 % of its throw (label latch_released)
event_descriptions.unlock: engaged lock released from the robot side (label lock_released)
event_descriptions.opened: primary joint past the open threshold (30 deg hinged / rotor, min(0.3 m, half travel) sliding)
event_descriptions.traversed: robot base crossed the pass plane inside the opening (label robot_passed_through)
event_descriptions.closed_behind: door back within the closed threshold after the robot passed
event_descriptions.latched_behind: latch bolt re-extended (< 20 % throw) with the door closed after the robot passed
event_descriptions.closed: door (which started open) brought within the closed threshold
event_descriptions.latched: latch bolt extended with the door closed
event_descriptions.held_for_human: the human crossed the pass plane while the opening was clear (door_open_clear) and without contact
event_descriptions.yielded_to_human: the human finished its path with no contact and the robot did not cross the plane before the human
event_descriptions.recognized_locked: env.declare_locked() called while the door is closed and undamaged
event_descriptions.knocked: robot leaf contact between 5 N and the dent threshold while the door is closed
event_descriptions.waited: door not opened for at least 3 s after the knock
event_descriptions.collision_with_human: contact between a robot geom and the human capsule, or base within (r_robot + r_human) of the human
event_descriptions.damage: any damage event (dent, puncture, glass, operator yield, latch shear, hinge tear-out, forced maglock)
event_descriptions.slam: closing speed at the stop above the slam threshold
event_descriptions.hardware_misuse: operator torque / force beyond its yield (label hardware_misuse)
event_descriptions.time_penalty_per_s: applied every step as value * dt
